import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial import ConvexHull

def hull_transform(g):
    bg=g[0][0]; points=np.array([(c,r) for r,row in enumerate(g) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v!=bg])
    hull=ConvexHull(points); poly=points[hull.vertices]
    def inside(x,y):
        # ray casting with boundary
        ins=False
        for i in range(len(poly)):
            x1,y1=poly[i]; x2,y2=poly[(i+1)%len(poly)]
            cross=(x-x1)*(y2-y1)-(y-y1)*(x2-x1)
            if abs(cross)<1e-9 and min(x1,x2)-1e-9<=x<=max(x1,x2)+1e-9 and min(y1,y2)-1e-9<=y<=max(y1,y2)+1e-9: return True
            if (y1>y)!=(y2>y) and x < (x2-x1)*(y-y1)/(y2-y1)+x1: ins=not ins
        return ins
    return [[(3 if v==bg and inside(c,r) else v) for c,v in enumerate(row)] for r,row in enumerate(g)]
